6 تصادروا [app. They returned together from water, &c.]. (A. [This meaning seems to be there indicated by the context.]) ―
-b2- And one says, تصادروا عَلَى مَا شَاؤُوا (tropical:) [app. meaning They released one another from being reckoned with, by mutual agreement, on such terms as they would: see 3]. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
